# Cylinder algebra generated by edge indicators

For $d \in \mathbb{N}$, the cylinder algebra is the real subalgebra of the continuous real functions on configurations of $\mathbb{Z}^d$ (assignments of open/closed states to all unordered pairs of sites) generated by the [edge indicators](idc-coord-cm.md) $\omega \mapsto \mathbf{1}[e \text{ open}]$, $e$ ranging over the unordered pairs of sites.
